title: 1+2+3+... = -1/12 is a label, not a sum
body: The series 1+2+3+... grows without bound and has no ordinary sum. The value -1/12 comes from the Riemann zeta function, defined by a convergent series elsewhere and uniquely extended (analytic continuation) to where -1 lives. String theory uses that extension; it does not claim a schoolchild's addition reaches a negative answer.
source_hint: Riemann zeta function and analytic continuation
